task.description: Step 0.5 + Step 1: registry lookup and root-cause diagnosis for ISS-0093 (GitHub #346). docs/issues/ISS-0093.json already contains a full diagnosis from the discovery during the ISS-0091 run: tests/integration/helpers.zig::applyCompatibilityShims() unconditionally runs ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE TRIGGER ALL against tenant_default.process_definitions, instance_projections, tasks, dead_letter_items, webhook_subscriptions, and webhook_deliveries, citing a GBL-081 resource_id uuid-to-text type mismatch as the reason. That mismatch was already fixed by migrations/GBL-082_fix_audit_chain_resource_id_text.sql (bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload and bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash both already accept TEXT). The shim was never removed after GBL-082 landed, so it silently disables the audit-chain trigger for every integration test, masking tests/integration/audit_iss103_test.zig's TC-ISS-103-INT-02/03/04. Confirm this diagnosis still holds against current main, update docs/issues/ISS-0093.json status/run_id if confirmed, and hand off root cause to CODE-DESIGNER.
acceptance_criteria: docs/issues/ISS-0093.json reviewed and confirmed accurate against current main
Root cause confirmed: stale post-GBL-082 compatibility shim in applyCompatibilityShims()
GitHub issue #346 cross-referenced (already present via rco-sync-ref)

result.summary: Diagnosis confirmed as-is against current main/branch state, no corrections needed. applyCompatibilityShims() (tests/integration/helpers.zig:208-230) still unconditionally runs ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE TRIGGER ALL on tenant_default.process_definitions/instance_projections/tasks/dead_letter_items/webhook_subscriptions/webhook_deliveries on every TestHarness.init() call (line 481). migrations/GBL-082_fix_audit_chain_resource_id_text.sql confirmed to have already corrected bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload() and bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash() to accept TEXT resource_id. tests/integration/audit_iss103_test.zig TC-ISS-103-INT-02/03/04 (lines 230, 307, 430) confirmed to assert audit_entries row counts that require the bpm_audit_on_mutation() trigger (attached to the six business tables per migrations/020_obs03_audit_entries.sql) to have fired. Traced full causal chain: shim disables that trigger -> no audit_entries rows -> tests fail their count assertions, independent of the (already-fixed) downstream chain-hash type mismatch. Checked all migrations after GBL-082 (GBL-083 through GBL-101, numeric 081-094): none reintroduce a uuid/text mismatch or touch bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash/bpm_audit_chain_canonical_payload again; GBL-084_rls_removal.sql touches the six tables only for RLS/tenant_id cleanup in the public schema, not trigger attachment, and does not affect tenant_default. No overlapping/duplicate local issue registration found in docs/issues/*.json or issue_index.json. Root cause confirmed: stale post-GBL-082 compatibility shim in applyCompatibilityShims() is the sole cause of the TC-ISS-103-INT-02/03/04 failures.
